timing_limit: 18 minutes is the sum of nominal training caps only. Probe, setup, full validation, numerical reload, final inference and posthoc metrics add time. One optimizer update can overshoot a cap. Actual throughput is not yet measured on these domain/strategy combinations.
stages: Each combination: original three-update actual forward/backward/optimizer resource probe, including inference target-value independence check.

Each combination: separate 180s budget fit with full-case/all-time validation. This normally supplies the whole sampled-case epoch check without a duplicate pilot. If no epoch completes, report the quality failure and obtain a validation-only budget decision before any test.
Report validation metrics, train-only baselines, timing/memory and selected versus all-executed exposure. Root selects the frozen checkpoint/profile using validation only.
Each selected checkpoint: fresh-process validation reload, normalized maximum prediction difference at most 1e-5, all SHA/source/contract gates.
Each selected checkpoint: single held-out final inference with started sentinel. Never retrain or overwrite after final starts.
Saved final NPZ only: arithmetic diagnostics, train-mean/zero/ballistic baseline metrics, centroid-removed displacement, raw EPSP support/history and scalar P95/max/hotspot error.
time_sampling: TC uses one future frame per case per sampled epoch with seeded balanced offsets. Ten complete sampled epochs expose every case-time pair once. AR/TF keep the original ten-step C3 rollout.
checkpoint_policy: Only complete sampled-case epochs can select checkpoints. Terminal partial work/validation is recorded but ineligible. Selected and total exposure are reported separately.
public_scope: Code, JSON, logs and PNG only; large private caches, raw final predictions, checkpoints and environments remain local.
not_claimed: full assembly original solver degrees of freedom
simple ranking against static 240s caps which exclude transfer
new-domain actual training before GPU allocation
